markers.reading: Play resumes on the morning of August 7 at the dry hillock in the upper Aursen marshes.

time.basis: DM states month, day and morning at u0200–u0203; year comes from compatible YAML.

evidence.quote: we pick up in the morning
It's August 7th in the morning.

markers.reading: The five travelers complete a flight of a couple of hours upriver to Three Wells.

duration.basis: DM narrates a couple of hours of completed flight.

evidence.quote: it takes you a couple of hours
you land, you shift back into people.

markers.reading: The arrival discussion at Three Wells is placed at about 11:30 a.m.

time.basis: DM contrasts current 11:30 with the ship’s 9 a.m. estimate; morning-to-midday flight supplies a.m. context.

evidence.quote: 9 AM was 96 hours away. It's now… say, 11.30, so it's 93 and a half hours away.

markers.reading: Delwath’s thought-reading interrogation runs to the end of its one-minute spell.

duration.basis: Spell duration explicitly stated and its ending narrated during the interrogation.

evidence.quote: Detect Thoughts only lasts a minute
Detect Thoughts is ending as he’s thinking.

markers.reading: Around midday Delwath takes an accepted short rest before scrying.

duration.basis: Short-rest convention; the DM accepts the rest-then-scry sequence and resolves the scry.

time.basis: Delwath calls it the middle of the day before the rest, and the DM accepts the sequence.

markers.note: The Dream proposal is not carried out after scrying shows the Empress awake.

evidence.quote: I want a short rest, and then I want to scry.
I’m gonna short rest, and then scry, and then cast Dream.
Scrying. Plus 5.
you… see… the camp.

markers.reading: Delwath’s scrying lasts ten minutes and ends after the sensor is blinded and shows strange flashes.

duration.basis: Duration confirmed at the table; the spell’s ending is then narrated.

evidence.quote: Scry lasts for 10 minutes.
Scry lasts for 10, I'm double checking. … what's the duration? Ten, that's yes.
and then the spell ends.

markers.reading: Two or three minutes into the scrying, the Empress blinds the sensor with flowing metal.

duration.basis: DM’s elapsed pacing interval before the Empress notices the sensor.

relations.note: This interval is inside the ten-minute scry and adds no extra elapsed time.

evidence.quote: after, like, 2-3 minutes, she stops.
wraps itself around the eye, which I’m gonna say blinds it, although you can still hear, I guess.

markers.reading: A good part of the afternoon passes while Delwath sends orders by lynx and the camp organizes troop movements.

duration.text: a good part of the afternoon
duration.basis: Narrated elapsed logistics; individual messenger journeys are nested, not separate party travel.

time.basis: DM explicitly places the message-sending interval in the afternoon.

evidence.quote: The afternoon passes with messages being sent.
This ends up taking… you know… a good part of the afternoon

markers.reading: By dinner time news of the plans has spread through Three Wells.

time.basis: DM’s current-play endpoint after the afternoon logistics.

evidence.quote: by, you know, dinner time… you know, news has spread… through the… through Three Wells

markers.reading: After the afternoon planning, the party settles into camp at night and catches up with Marcella.

time.basis: DM explicitly establishes the night-camp conversation after the afternoon planning.

markers.note: The afternoon planning overlaps the already narrated message-sending period; it is not another afternoon.

evidence.quote: you spend the afternoon plotting and planning.
As you settle in… to camp this night

markers.reading: The party drifts off for the night as the session ends; the overnight rest has begun.

time.basis: Closing narration establishes drifting off, without waking or completed overnight passage.

evidence.quote: Leaves you to your rest
As you drift off for the night

yamlCheck.dateAnchor: August 7 and morning are spoken at u0200–u0203. The year 1749 is YAML-derived. The resumed morning, flight, midday spell sequence, afternoon logistics and night camp all belong to this same date.
yamlCheck.explanation: The full played interval runs from the resumed morning through drifting off that night. No waking, completed overnight rest or next-day event is established. The remembered 2 a.m. Marcella conversation belongs to the previous session’s handoff; forecasts, imagined sunset during an oath, and future attacks do not extend this session.
